_note: PAT-235. Scenario 19's seven patients and proportion measure (p1 72M, p2 69M, p3 67F, p4 62F, p5 57F, p6 42M, p7 32F; IP = adults, Denom = 50+, Numer = 65+) with the classic boolean `gender` stratifier (group-level) and one ARTIFACT-level multi-component stratifier `sex-age` = sex (Patient.gender.value) × age band (18-49 / 50-64 / 65+), as the eCQM workspace builds it. Locks: the CQL has one define per component (`Stratifier sex-age sex`, `Stratifier sex-age age`); a patient's stratum is the combination (`female | 50-64`), reported with per-component values; the male 50-64 cell has nobody and therefore no stratum (exactStrata: exactly the five combinations that occur); per-stratum populations and scores (18-49 cells have an empty denominator → no score). Runs on PostgreSQL with V74 (`measure_report_stratifier.component_values`) applied by Flyway.
